# Geist v1.9.2

Copies of `dist/fonts/geist-sans/Geist-Variable.woff2` and
`dist/fonts/geist-mono/GeistMono-Variable.woff2` from the
[geist](https://github.com/vercel/geist-font) package v1.9.2 (SIL Open Font
License 1.1, see LICENSE), unchanged: the typeface of Orca's app, whose look
the admin page and the dev page take (docs/specs/approved/hi_pages_design.md).
hi embeds them and serves them beside `dev.css` (`geist.woff2`,
`geist-mono.woff2`) on the admin page, the dev page, and the app's own pages
for the helper, so every computer draws the same letters. They are variable
fonts: one file a family, every weight.
